adjudication.rationale: In new `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the message handler validates the sender with `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`. This is a substring check rather than an exact origin match, so an origin that is merely contained within `discourseUrl` (including being a prefix, as described) will be accepted and can send `{type:'discourse-resize', height: ...}` to control the iframe height. The diff clearly introduces this insecure origin validation logic in the newly added embed script.
